messages:
Mike: Quick ping — can we nudge the biweekly release train cutoff next Wed by ~2 hours? Theres a regional holiday that impacts a couple of our infra folks and we also have a last-minute SDK version bump to land.
Priya: Hmm, moving cutoff could squeeze QA. What time currently?
Mike: Current cutoff is 18:00 UTC. Proposal: shift to 20:00 UTC for that week only.
Jess: +1 for avoiding people working during the holiday. We should flag changelog owners so they can run quick smoke checks. @Priya will that work for regression windows?
Priya: I can accept the bump if we get a hard freeze on merges an extra 30m earlier (so we have time to run a couple of scripted smoke suites). Otherwise risk of rushed fixes.
Rohan: Re branch coordination — pls call out cherry-picks. If we move cutoff, Ill open a short-lived branch "rc/preflight-<date>" to collect the urgent SDK bump and any small fixes. People should PR against that, not main.
Jess: Good idea. Add a note in the PR template: "TARGET: rc/preflight-2024-11-06" or whatever date.
Mike: OpsBot — can you confirm no deploy windows already scheduled that night?
OpsBot: Scheduled windows check: no active deploy windows at 20:00 UTC on 2024-11-06. Reminder: automated canary runs are at 19:30 UTC; moving cutoff to 20:00 will not conflict.
Rohan: For the cherry-pick process, please follow this quick flow:
```
# from main
git checkout -b rc/preflight-2024-11-06
git cherry-pick <commit>
open PR -> target: rc/preflight-2024-11-06
```
Keep PRs small. Merge policy: 1 approver + green CI.
Priya: Ill schedule the smoke suite to run at 19:35 and again at 19:50. If either fails we abort the cutoff bump.
Jess: Changelog owners: @Mike, @Jess, @Priya — please add a short entry for the SDK bump and mark as "skip-auto" if it's not customer-facing. Ill send a quick nudge to docs to prevent surprises.
Mike: Thanks. Can folks ack here so I can update the release calendar?
Rohan: Ack from me. Ill create the rc branch after the bump commit lands.
Priya: Ack. Will run the smoke checks.
Jess: Ack. Ill update the PR template and ping docs.
Mike: Cool — Ill patch the calendar for that week with new cutoff 20:00 UTC and add a note: "one-time holiday bump + SDK vX.Y.Z."
Mike: If anything changes, reply here. Otherwise Ill close this thread after calendar update. :thumbsup:
